comment: One populated stripboard (21x19) with LM386, PT2399 and 78L05; a modded Midfi Clari(not). Two resistors are printed only as LED and LDR LED, an LED (D4) and a GL5549 LDR sit on the board, a second GL5549 is mounted externally. The legend gives 'Delay/Depth B250k' on one line while the wire labels show separate Delay and Depth lugs; the Tracking wires have no pot in the legend and the legend's Lag pot has no wires, so they are probably the same pot.
uncertain: Delay/Depth B250k: read as two B250K pots (separate Delay and Depth lugs in the wire labels); could be meant as one
Lag B1k: the wire labels call a pot 'Tracking' and none 'Lag'; assumed to be the same pot
Trimmer 25k: taken to be the square part at columns 18-20, rows H-J, which carries no printed value
rows: value not given; on the board beside the LDR
LDR; one on the board (printed 5549), one external mount
footswitch; omit without the external LDR
